annotation.title_clean: Advisory Circular (AC) No. 903-001 – Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems Operational Risk Assessment
annotation.title_en: Advisory Circular (AC) No. 903-001 – Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems Operational Risk Assessment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Transport Canada, Civil Aviation, Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems Task Force
annotation.summary_en: Transport Canada advisory circular giving manufacturers and operators guidance on operational risk assessment for remotely piloted aircraft systems, based on JARUS SORA, supporting Special Flight Operations Certificate applications. Covers ground and air risk, SAIL determination, containment, detect-and-avoid, operational safety objectives and standard scenarios.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to RPAS operations requiring a risk assessment for an SFOC under CARs Part IX Subpart 3
Based on JARUS SORA: ground risk, air risk, SAIL determination
Sets containment, detect-and-avoid and operational safety objectives
Excludes passenger-carrying, dangerous payloads, air-to-air collision risks and type-certified aircraft
Includes standard scenarios and reliability targets
